wb = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

# Modify only the requested cells G3:G5.
# New logic:
# - If M has a value, use F - M
# - If M is blank and J has a value, use F - J
# - If both J and M are blank/empty-string, use F - 0, which displays F
# - Preserve the original outer IF behavior for negative/blank F
